WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.o_orderpriority,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS order_month,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate)
),
ranked_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        orderpriority,
        order_month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY orderpriority ORDER BY order_month) AS prev_month_revenue,
        revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY orderpriority ORDER BY order_month) AS mom_change,
        ROUND(
            (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY orderpriority ORDER BY order_month)) / 
            NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY orderpriority ORDER BY order_month), 0) * 100, 
            2
        ) AS mom_change_pct
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    orderpriority,
    order_month,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(prev_month_revenue, 2) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND(mom_change, 2) AS mom_change_value,
    mom_change_pct
FROM ranked_changes
WHERE prev_month_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_change_pct) DESC
LIMIT 20

-- Calculate supplier efficiency based on on-time delivery
-- Efficient: l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate (on-time or early)
-- Inefficient: l_receiptdate > l_commitdate (late)

WITH supplier_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_nationkey,
        n.n_name AS nation_name,
        n.n_regionkey,
        r.r_name AS region_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_shipments,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_deliveries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate > l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_deliveries
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name
),
efficiency_classified AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN on_time_deliveries * 1.0 / total_shipments >= 0.9 THEN 'Efficient'
            WHEN on_time_deliveries * 1.0 / total_shipments < 0.7 THEN 'Inefficient'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS efficiency_category
    FROM supplier_performance sp
)
SELECT 
    region_name,
    efficiency_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_count,
    ROUND(AVG(on_time_deliveries * 1.0 / total_shipments) * 100, 1) AS avg_on_time_pct
FROM efficiency_classified
GROUP BY region_name, efficiency_category
ORDER BY region_name, efficiency_category
